ana (partnerships): Quick sync 1: Glacier Systems wants a joint preview: hardware in their lab + our marketplace listing pilot. Need NDA status, listing assets, and who signs the integration SOW.
ravi (eng-platform): NDA signed yesterday by Glacier. I pulled the doc from the vault.
clare (pm): For marketplace we need logos, short description (<=200 chars), FAQ, and a verified performance snippet. Glacier can host the image but we push the connector.
glacier-ops (external): Confirmed. We'll provide images and a short marketing blurb. We expect no public numbers until post-review.
nana (typo) -- wait typo.
nana not involved.
nana?
ops-bot: reminder: scheduled lab window Thu 08:00-11:00 PT.
nana (partnerships): sorry ignore previous typo.
clare (pm): Integration SOW: can legal draft a short addendum for marketplace co-marketing and data handling? Need to note telemetry retention (90 days max).
security (legal): We can draft a 1-pg addendum. Willers from legal will take it. Also request: firmware disclosure checklist before we run any bench.
ravi (eng-platform): Technical: we'll run two passes: (1) baseline fp16 single-stream; (2) quantized INT8. Sample run: `./bench_tool --model=redwood-mini --seq=2048 --concurrency=2 --telemetry=summary --out=glacier-run.json`
clare (pm): Add a small manual regression set (15 prompts) focused on hallucination/rerank cases.
glacier-ops (external): We require the harness checksum and a signed binary hash before we run anything on our network.
nana (partnerships): adding checksum request to the checklist.
ops-bot: bench-job queued by ravi (job 12987)
ravi (eng-platform): Dry-run on our infra succeeded. No firmware issues. Uploading signed manifest to secure drive. Link: https://redwood.internal/manifests/12987/signed-manifest.txt
glacier-ops (external): Received manifest. Our on-site will verify binary. We'll also run a quick power-cycling test before bench.
clare (pm): Embargo: tentative lift 2026-05-04 09:00 PT. Marketing to confirm. No partner logos in public materials without written sign-off.
security (legal): Confirmed, will include embargo clause in addendum.
ravi (eng-platform): Telemetry set: gpu_util, mem_stats, token_throughput, p50/p95 latency, rpc_errors. Sampling 1s. We'll redact any input text from shared artifacts.
glacier-ops (external): We can allow SSH bastion access from redwood-bastion IP 198.51.100.12/32 during the window. Will add to allowlist.
nana (partnerships): Action list: 1) Legal to draft addendum (security). 2) Ravi run preview bench Thu 08:15 PT and post sanitized artifact. 3) Clare coordinate marketplace assets + embargo note. 4) Glacier to verify binary and confirm bastion IP allowlist.
clare (pm): I'll prepare the marketplace short description and draft the FAQ. Sharing assets by EOD Wed.
ravi (eng-platform): I'll paste the sanitized artifact and a small compare vs baseline (delta %) after the run.
glacier-ops (external): On-site lead: Marco. He'll ping when verification complete.
nana (partnerships): Thanks all. Please drop any final pre-run issues here by EOD Wed. :thumbsup:
